mechanisms.description: Every phase close regenerates all snapshots. No snapshot survives more than one phase gap.
Before mounting, snapshot freshnessStatus is checked. STALE/UNKNOWN snapshots are rejected.
Snapshot generated_at is compared against latest phase-ledger entry. If snapshot is older, it is STALE.
Snapshots older than 2 completed phases are auto-RETIRED during phase close cleanup.
If all snapshots are stale, Attach Packet v3 provides a single-point fallback.
Post-phase-close check ensures all snapshots are FRESH before declaring mount-ready.

what_constitutes_stale: generated_at older than latest phase-ledger timestamp
snapshot references completed phase as current
frozen_conclusions missing newly-added items from last phase
verdict: Stale snapshot prevention is structural, not advisory. Phase close auto-refresh + mount validation + fallback chain form a defense-in-depth against staleness.
